label: TP
reason: User-supplied header value flows via URL decoding into bar, which is then used to construct a file URI ('file:' scheme). The resulting File object is passed to ESAPI.encodeForHTML() and printed to HTML response. While encodeForHTML protects against XSS, it does not sanitize the file path component itself. An attacker can inject directory traversal sequences (e.g., '../etc/passwd') into the header to read arbitrary server files, constituting a genuine Path Traversal vulnerability.

evidence.note: User header input is retrieved and URL decoded into param.
Switch logic allows param to flow directly to bar variable based on switch target.
bar is concatenated into file URI string which includes untrusted user input.
File constructed from potentially malicious URI is used as argument to ESAPI encoder.
